tasks.subject: Add release automation for binaries and GHCR images
tasks.description: Add GoReleaser and GitHub Actions release configuration that builds promshim binaries for common platforms, publishes binaries/checksums to GitHub Releases, and publishes runtime images to ghcr.io/badliveware/promshim-clickhouse on version tags.

tasks.subject: Validate release build locally
tasks.description: Run local non-publishing release validation (GoReleaser check/snapshot if available, Docker build, go tests/vet) and document any credentials/tag prerequisites for actual publishing.

tasks.subject: Publish tagged release after version confirmation
tasks.description: After the user confirms the release tag/version, commit the open-source cleanup and release automation changes if requested, create and push the tag, then let the GitHub Actions release workflow publish binaries to GitHub Releases and images to ghcr.io/badliveware/promshim-clickhouse. Verify the release and image after publishing.
